def historical_query(records, queries):
    out = []
    for key, at, known_at in queries:
        candidates = [r for r in records if r['key'] == key and r['valid_from'] <= at < r['valid_to'] and r['seen_at'] <= known_at]
        if not candidates: out.append(None); continue
        r = max(candidates, key=lambda r: (r['revision'], r['seen_at'], r['id']))
        out.append(None if r['deleted'] else r['value'])
    return out
